summary: Backend-only test of the new On Demand content library (Stage 1). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_on_demand_library.py with 43 pytest test cases covering categories, tags, item validation, item CRUD (workout/video/audio), coach list filters, PATCH (content_type immutability, workout_json guarded to workout only, thumbnail/media replace), publish toggle, public visibility rules (coach vs client on unpublished), presigned media-url + thumbnail-url endpoints, category/tag deletion cascade to items, and item deletion. 42 passed, 1 skipped (constructing a non-workout item with no media is not possible via the public API surface, so `item_has_no_media` on media-url couldn't be exercised — flagged for follow-up but not a blocker). No 5xx errors, no serialization/ObjectId issues observed. R2 driver live — uploads, presigns and replacement flows all worked end-to-end.

minor.issue: The `item_has_no_media` 404 branch cannot be reached via public API — workout items short-circuit to 400 and video/audio require media at create time and PATCH never clears media_storage_key. Consider adding coverage via a direct DB mutation in tests, or expose a way to clear media.
Passing `content_type` in the body is silently ignored because it isn't on ItemPatchBody. Behaviour is correct (immutable) but a hint/warning log would help API consumers who might expect an error.
No 404 test path failed; but response body does not surface count of items detached (nice-to-have for coach UI).

action_items: Consider extending PATCH to allow clearing media (set media=null) so the 'item_has_no_media' branch on /media-url is reachable; then add a matching test.
Optional: return item counts touched by category/tag delete in the response for coach UX.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_on_demand.py is 546 lines — well-scoped, single-purpose, and under the 700-line soft cap. No refactor needed.
Payload validation happens BEFORE any R2 write in create — good, avoids orphan bytes.
PATCH correctly performs best-effort R2 cleanup on old key when replacing thumbnail/media with a different extension.
workout_json is stripped from coach list results via projection ({workout_json: 0}) — verified working.
content_type is enforced immutable by simply not exposing it on ItemPatchBody — clean approach.
All responses correctly exclude MongoDB _id (verified across list, get, create, patch endpoints).
Idempotent category/tag creation via slug matching works with whitespace + case variants — verified with `TEST_Dup_xxxx` vs `  TEST_DUP_XXXX  `.
Client role is properly rejected from /coach/* endpoints (401/403).
Presigned URLs returned with mime + expires_in + driver fields; TTL is 30 minutes as coded.

success_rate.frontend: N/A — not in scope for Stage 1

seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_-prefixed categories, tags, and items and tear them down in a module-scoped fixture. Verified via list endpoints — no lingering rows after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endpoint surface covered by /app/backend/tests/test_on_demand_library.py. When Stage 2 (client browse/playback UI) lands, extend the same file with member-facing filters and playback wiring. The one skipped test (`test_item_without_media_returns_404_on_media_url`) documents an unreachable branch — either add a way to clear media in PATCH or remove that 404 branch as dead code.
